population: Same 124 current-gate-passing zero-FTS DRF races on 22 cards, 921 runners; 17 blank-program races remain excluded.
current_context: Existing centered feature-8 contribution from the frozen parent, not recomputed or refitted.
pressure_proxy: When all field Early values are available and top-two gap <=5, pressure=(number within 5 points of maximum Early -1)/(field size -1); otherwise 0.
clear_lead_proxy: When all field Early values are available and top-two gap >=10, clear_strength=min(1,gap/20); otherwise 0. Only the uniquely highest-Early horse receives an early-advantage bonus.
replacement: 0.05 * pressure * centered_Late + 0.05 * clear_strength * I(unique highest Early); pressure and clear branches are mutually exclusive, so absolute replacement <=0.05.
centered_Late: Same [-1,1] field-relative centered percentile convention as frozen Contender; ties share values, missing Late or non-discriminating field is neutral 0.
candidate_score: NO_CONTEXT score plus replacement. No redistribution or re-estimation of other terms.
missingness: Any unknown field Early or FTS withholds replacement for entire field. Missing individual Late gives zero pressure contribution. No style proxies or future observations are used.
support_level: Research proxy using verified TimeformUS summaries; running-style/actual-tempo validation remains incomplete. This does not certify a duel or lone lead.
parameters: One fixed small candidate; cutoffs inherited from Step 2 primary diagnostic. Cap chosen as an exploratory small score term before this replay, not optimized. No grid search or outcome-based retuning.
primary_metric: Relative order among the actual top four: all six pairs, with complete rank coverage.
comparisons: Report replacement versus no-context to isolate what the new term adds, as well as both versus current. Report trigger counts and changed orders separately.
uncertainty: Descriptive paired whole-card bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20261021; repeated selected development data cannot establish independent predictive gains.
outcome_separation: Scoring whitelist excludes actual finishes; predictions saved before grading. Previously reviewed outcomes mean this is never a prospective test.
